notes: Two sayings. Saying 1 is the story of Musa's arrest, with three routes: Nawfali's line, the Alawi's line, and «غيرهما» who give only part of the story. Saying 2 is the Imam's quoted hadith («نعم، حدثني أبي، عن آبائه، عن رسول الله»), stored as its own group (rule 4a)

needs_ruling: «قالوا» is an unnamed plural speaker of the compiled story; and the Imam who speaks inside the story is not written as a link of saying 2 (his own line gives only «أبي» and «آبائه»), a placement the rules do not settle
«قال الأصبهاني» and «قال الأصبهاني: وحدثني» are the same Isfahani speaking again; the second route begins at him
